revision_reason: Official 2022 NHTS V2.1 data were supplied and processed.
Overnight vehicle windows were corrected to the noon-to-noon horizon.
The pre-data urgency factor was replaced by a weighted NHTS urgency quantile.
A controlled common native-load profile was frozen because the study isolates network-model bias rather than forecasts chronological demand.

behavior_data.dataset: 2022 NextGen NHTS Public Use CSV V2.1
behavior_data.sampling: weighted resampling without replacement within each scenario; call-time availability enforced

native_load_profile.purpose: isolate feeder topology and balanced-vs-unbalanced model effects
native_load_profile.prohibited_claim: not an empirical regional load forecast

claim_gates.deliverable: All materially changed intervals pass nonlinear three-phase power flow; departure and reserve violations are zero; no simultaneous charge/discharge.
claim_gates.applicability_region: Holdout false-safe rate <=5% and at least 20 holdout observations.
claim_gates.directional_bias: Within-feeder paired bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero and direction reproduced in holdout data.
